description: Find personal trainers listed on UK Fitness Pro, a directory of personal trainers across the United Kingdom. Give a UK town, city, area or postcode as `location` (or `online: true` for trainers who coach remotely). Returns trainers within about 12 miles (20km), nearest first, with a link to each profile and to the full results page on the site. Use get_trainer_profile for a trainer's description, qualifications and pricing. If the resolved location is not the place the user meant (check `area`), call find_location and pass latitude/longitude instead. Verified means UK Fitness Pro has checked this trainer's identity documents. It does not confirm qualifications or insurance, which are as stated by the trainer. Most listed trainers are not verified. Listing is free, so absence of a badge says nothing negative.

latitude.description: Use with longitude instead of location, e.g. a coordinate from find_location.

limit.description: Maximum trainers to return. Default 10, maximum 25.

location.description: UK town, city, area or postcode, e.g. "Leeds", "Clapham", "M1 1AE", "SW19".

longitude.description: Use with latitude instead of location.

online.description: true for trainers offering online/remote coaching, regardless of location.

sort.description: distance (default; online searches are ordered verified first, then most recently updated) or price (lowest "from" price first; trainers without a price last).

speciality.description: Only trainers listing a matching speciality, e.g. "weight loss", "rehabilitation", "boxing", "pre and postnatal". Matched loosely against the trainer's own speciality list.

name: search_trainers
title: Search personal trainers
